slide1.subtitle: Your whole household sees the same month: how much there is, how much you can spend today, and what's coming.

slide2.title: One clear number for the whole household.
slide2.subtitle: Whether you run it alone or with someone, everyone sees the same thing. No more spreadsheets or arguments over different numbers.

slide3.title: Fixed, income and the day-to-day.
slide3.subtitle: Add your fixed expenses once and we show how much they swing and how much they weigh on your pay. Plus any income that comes in.

slide4.title: Every day you log, you plant a sprout.
slide4.subtitle: A full week and your garden blooms. And if one day you can't, that's okay: the garden waits for you, no guilt.

slide5.subtitle: You get the whole app from day one. Then you choose whether to keep going. No card to start.

exitDialog.title: Leave setup?
exitDialog.message: Your progress is saved. You can sign out and come back to the start whenever you want.

income.title: Your base salary
income.subcopy: We use it to work out your daily budget.
income.cycleHint: You can always edit it from Settings.
income.dynamicInfoTitle: Your budget builds up as money comes in
income.dynamicInfoBody: No fixed salary needed: whenever money comes in, log it as income and your balance and daily allowance update instantly. Ideal for freelancers, sales or irregular income.

incomeContribution.title: Do you contribute to the household income?
incomeContribution.subcopy: If you have a salary or income, we add it to the household total. If you don't (a child, a partner without a job, etc.), that's fine too.
incomeContribution.hintContributes: It's added to the household's total income. You can edit it from Settings anytime.
incomeContribution.infoNoContribute: Done — nothing is added to the household income. If you start contributing at some point, you can turn it on from Settings.
